sections.Profile:
Kewpie Doll, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1960, is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a carnival shooting-gallery theme, designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. It was the last wood-rail machine Gottlieb built, in a run of 950 units.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1960
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Carnival, Original Theme, Shooting, Guns
